notice: This letter serves as formal notice that your engagement as an unpaid Internal Contributor with AfriVate Technologies Ltd, under the AfriVate Internal Contributor Engagement Framework (AFRI-ICEF-01), is being brought to an end with immediate effect.
groundsIntro: This decision follows your continued unresponsiveness on official AfriVate communication channels — including Slack and the AfriVate Portal — for a period exceeding two (2) weeks. Despite reasonable attempts by your Team Lead and People & Culture to reach you, no update, acknowledgement, or explanation was received within this period. This conduct constitutes a breach of the following AfriVate policies:
grounds: AFRI-ICEF-01 (Internal Contributor Engagement Framework), §5 – Contributor Obligations, which requires you to meet commitments, keep Portal records accurate, and acknowledge official Slack messages within four (4) hours on official work days during core hours;

AFRI-SWP (Standard Work Process), §6.1 – the four-hour Slack acknowledgement rule, §7.2 – keeping Portal tasks and Weekly check-ins current, and §12 – Discipline and Corrective Action, under which prolonged, unexplained disengagement is treated as a conduct trigger;

AFRI-PDP-01 (Penalty & Disciplinary Policy), §6.1 – Attendance, Availability, and Leave, which classifies prolonged, unexplained disengagement from Portal and Slack activity during an active Agreed Capacity period as a Category C offense warranting suspension review and, on continuation, end of engagement; and

AFRI-EOH-01 (Team Member Onboarding Handbook), §5 – Communication Standards, and §7 – Performance, KPIs, and Reporting, which require timely Portal updates and Weekly check-ins even where progress is limited.
surviving: Please note that your confidentiality obligations and the assignment of intellectual property in any Work Product under AFRI-ICEF-01 §5.4 and §6 survive the end of this engagement. You remain prohibited from disclosing any AfriVate Confidential Information to a third party without prior written authorisation from AfriVate. A breach of this obligation may result in AfriVate taking appropriate legal action against you.
financial: As this engagement was unpaid internal contribution and did not constitute a contract of employment, no severance, notice pay, salary, stipend, or other financial entitlement arises from this end of engagement, consistent with AFRI-ICEF-01's binding status disclaimer.
closing: AfriVate appreciates your prior contributions and wishes you success in your future endeavours.
